title: Lake Manyara Day Excursion
description: Lake Manyara Day Excursion offers a relaxing and memorable safari in the beautiful Lake Manyara National Park, located just a short drive from Arusha. This park is known for its diverse scenery—from green forests to open plains and the famous soda lake giving you a chance to see a variety of wildlife in one place. You may spot tree-climbing lions, elephants, giraffes, zebras, and colorful birds, including flamingos.

With a private tour, you enjoy a flexible and comfortable experience tailored to your pace and interests. Take your time on game drives, enjoy a picnic in nature, and learn from your guide along the way. It’s a perfect one-day safari for anyone looking for a simple, personal, and unforgettable wildlife experience.

itinerary.title: Go - Return
itinerary.text: Morning: Departure from Arusha6:00 AM – Pick up from your hotel in Arusha and drive to Lake Manyara National Park, enjoying beautiful views along the way. Mid-Morning: Game DriveAround 9:00–10:00 AM – Arrive at the park and start your game drive. See wildlife like elephants, giraffes, monkeys, and if lucky, the famous tree-climbing lions. You’ll also spot many birds, including flamingos. Lunch Break12:30 PM – Enjoy a picnic lunch inside the park. Afternoon & Return1:30 PM – Continue the game drive and enjoy the scenery.4:00–6:00 PM – Drive back to Arusha and drop off at your hotel in the evening.
